edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 2

source_text: Et factum est, cum extolleret Moyses manus suas, invalescebat Israel; cum deiceret, invalescebat Amalec. Tunc invalescit Iesus et vincit, quando Moyses erigit manus. Cessante lege apud illos demissae sunt manus Moysi. Nadab et Abiud et Eleazar et Iothor derelinquuntur ut iudicent populum; Iesus non derelinquitur sed sequitur Moysen in montem et assistebat Moysi — non ut secundus, sed ut adiutor. Cum exploratum missus, nomen eius Ause scribitur; cum redit et erigit populum, a Moyse Iesus nominatur. In transfiguratione vultus Moysi, Iesus in interioribus tabernaculi mysteriorum conscius perseverat.
pass_a_gloss: And it-happened, when was-raising Moses hands his, was-prevailing Israel; when he-was-casting-down, was-prevailing Amalek. Then grows-strong Jesus and conquers, when Moses raises hands. With-law-ceasing among them lowered were hands of-Moses. Nadab and Abihu and Eleazar and Jethro are-left that they-may-judge the-people; Jesus is-not left but follows Moses onto mountain and was-standing-by Moses — not as second, but as helper. When to-spy sent, name his Ause is-written; when he-returns and raises the-people, by Moses Jesus is-named. In transfiguration of-face of-Moses, Jesus in interiors of-tabernacle of-mysteries aware remains.
pass_b_english: [[When Moses lifted his hands, Israel prevailed; when he let them fall, Amalek prevailed >> Bible:Exodus 17:11]]. Jesus grows strong and conquers when Moses raises his hands. The people were beaten by Amalek when Moses’ hands hung down — when the law ceased among them who, [[seeking to establish their own righteousness, were not subject to the righteousness of God >> Bible:Romans 10:3]]. Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Jethro are left to judge the people; Jesus is not left behind but follows Moses up the mountain and [[stood by Moses >> Bible:Exodus 24:13]] — not as second or inferior, but as helper and protector. When he was sent to spy, his name is written Hosea (Ause); when he returns and lifts the fallen people, Moses names him Jesus. When Moses’ face was transfigured and Israel could not bear the sight, Jesus not only looks on the face but remains inside the tabernacle, privy to the mysteries.
